design_system.font_strategy: System sans for interface and body copy, Georgia serif for editorial headlines, system monospace for evidence labels.
responsive_rules: At 1440px the content shell caps at 1180px and homepage narrative sections use two- to four-column layouts.
At 768px hero, loop, mistakes, and guide content collapse to single-column reading order while related links become a two-column footer-like block.
At 375px desktop navigation becomes a keyboard-accessible details menu, all cards stack, CTA controls span the available width, and long IDs wrap without overflow.
